messages:
joan: Quick note — recurring 'cache thrash -> p95 jump -> autoscaler ping-pong' seen in last two postmortems. Starting this thread to assign runbook/playbook changes.

ravi: Can we add a 1-line first-responder checklist? saves time during noisy incidents.

kelly: I'll own the runbook edit. Creating ticket RW-4905. Will add 'Quick Triage', 'Mitigations', and explicit rollback steps. Target PR by 2026-04-07.

mike: I'll update alerting to add `kv_cache_eviction_rate` panel + suppression (require 3 consecutive 1m buckets) and a composite alert to reduce flapping. ETA 48h.

joan: Suggested playbook thresholds: eviction > 2% for 3m = notify (Slack); eviction > 6% for 5m OR token_p95 > 1s = page SRE lead. Also require any temporary routing/model-pin changes be annotated with `postmortem-RW-4905`.

kelly: Adding the operator snippets to the runbook now so first responders can copy/paste:
```
# quick checks
curl -s "https://prometheus/api/v1/query?query=kv_cache_eviction_rate[1m]"
# quick mitigation: lower batch size on affected pool
redwoodctl deploy --pool serve-main --set batch_size=5
# pin to low-mem variant temporarily
redwoodctl route set --model product-api --variant lowmem-v1 --note "postmortem-RW-4905"
```

infra-bot: InfraBot: ticket RW-4905 created and assigned to @kelly. Due 2026-04-07.

ravi: Action items recap:
- kelly: runbook + playbook edits (RW-4905) — due 2026-04-07
- mike: dashboards + suppressed composite alert — due 2026-03-30
- joan: synth one-line triage + owner matrix — due 2026-03-29

joan: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after RW-4905 PR lands and after alerts are live. If blocked, escalate to infra-eng lead. :white_check_mark:
